canonical_reduction.claim: every 3CNF F partitions exactly as F=H AND D with H Horn and D dual-Horn
canonical_reduction.construction: put every clause with <=1 positive literal in H; every remaining clause has <=1 negative literal and goes to D
canonical_reduction.interpretation: unrestricted Horn x dual-Horn interaction already contains arbitrary 3SAT

qhorn_compatibility_certificate.source: Gaspers et al., Backdoors to q-Horn, STACS 2013; Boros-Hammer-Sun characterization
qhorn_compatibility_certificate.certificate: beta(l) in {0,1/2,1}, beta(x)=1-beta(not x), sum_{l in C} beta(l)<=1
qhorn_compatibility_certificate.recognition: quadratic cover F2 + implication graph D(F2) + SCC-derived canonical beta-hat
qhorn_compatibility_certificate.obstruction: non-q-Horn => violating triple in one SCC of D(F2), computable in linear time
